About us

Movement. Confidence. A little more you, every day.

01

Our mission

To help you make space for movement, build confidence and create habits that fit your everyday life.

Fit is Lit brings together goal-focused prerecorded classes and practical nutrition guidance, so you can take your next step with a clear focus.

02

Our vision

A community where starting feels possible, progress is personal and fitness becomes part of everyday life.

03

Our story

Founded by Faith Sheba Gamde, Fit is Lit is built around movement, confidence and the everyday commitment to keep going.
